name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official Biology PhD information available; no published application deadline. Admission model is not stated. Program and catalog prerequisites differ; confirm required preparation with the department.

english.note: University policy also lists PTE Academic60, MELAB77 and iTEP Academic-Plus3.5; program may set higher standards.

requirements.note: Biology bachelor's required; M.S. recommended. Catalog requires acceptable general GRE (subject GRE not required), recommends M.S. GPA3.5+, and lists biology/chemistry year, physics course, genetics, organic chemistry or biochemistry, precalculus and statistics; select prerequisites may be waived by EBS committee. Main program page instead lists a year of physics and organic chemistry. Confirm this discrepancy. Applications accepted at any time; catalog review starts in February for autumn.

funding.note: Research assistantships are competitively awarded; no universal funding guarantee stated.
